nodes.title: Implement Pauli basis conversion functions
nodes.description: Implement the public functions `to_superpauli` and `superpauli_to_super` for converting between column-stacking superoperator representation and Pauli basis representation. The `to_superpauli` function should convert a superoperator from column-stacking basis to Pauli basis (wrapping or replacing the existing internal `_to_superpauli`). The `superpauli_to_super` function should implement the inverse transformation, converting from Pauli basis back to column-stacking basis. Both functions should validate that the input has qubit dimensions using `isqubitdims`, and should include proper docstrings with Parameters, Returns, and Raises sections following the existing code style.
nodes.expected_output: Function definitions with signatures `to_superpauli(q_oper: Qobj) -> Qobj` and `superpauli_to_super(q_oper: Qobj) -> Qobj`, with comprehensive docstrings explaining the conversion, parameters, return values, and potential exceptions.

nodes.title: Update module exports
nodes.description: Add the new function names 'to_superpauli' and 'superpauli_to_super' to the module's `__all__` list to make them part of the public API, maintaining alphabetical order with existing exports.
nodes.expected_output: Updated `__all__` list containing all existing exports plus 'superpauli_to_super' and 'to_superpauli' in alphabetical order.

nodes.title: Final assembly of complete file
nodes.description: Integrate the new conversion functions and updated exports into the complete Python file. Place the new public functions in an appropriate location within the module (near other `to_*` conversion functions), ensure all existing imports and functions remain intact, and verify the file structure is consistent with the original.
nodes.expected_output: The complete modified Python file with all changes integrated, from the first import to the last line, including the new `to_superpauli` and `superpauli_to_super` functions and updated `__all__` list.
